name: Creating Space to Score
summary: Back out of pressure with your handle, relocate for open shots, finish with the inside hand, and push through a tired-legs dribble finisher.

drills.name: Retreat Dribble Resets
drills.summary: Back away from pressure, keep the ball safe, then attack again.
steps: Set two cones 3 big steps apart.
Attack the far cone with 3 hard dribbles.
At the cone, take 2 quick retreat dribbles back. Stay low and keep your chest to the cone.
Reset with a crossover and attack again.
Go 90 seconds with your right hand, then 90 seconds with your left.

drills.name: Relocate & Rise
drills.summary: Pass it off, move to an open spot, and be ready to shoot on the catch.
steps: Start on the wing with the ball.
Spin the ball out to yourself toward the corner, or toss it off the backboard.
Slide 2-3 steps to a new spot, either the corner or the slot.
Catch with your feet already set and shoot.
Rebound, go back to the wing, and switch which way you relocate each rep.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Finishes
drills.summary: Finish with the hand closer to the middle so you can score around a defender.
steps: Put a cone at the block as a shot blocker.
Drive from the wing toward the cone.
Take your last step past the cone and finish with your inside hand, off the glass.
Do 2 minutes from the right side, then 2 minutes from the left.
Count your makes and try to beat it next time.

drills.name: Four-Corner Dribble Sprints
drills.summary: Sprint-dribble a box and change hands at every corner while your legs burn.
steps: Set 4 cones in a square, about 8 big steps per side.
Speed dribble to the first cone with your right hand.
Crossover at the cone and sprint to the next one with your left.
Keep going around the box for 40 seconds, then rest 20 seconds.
Do 3 rounds. Switch directions each round.
